verdict.rationale: Pigment documents the main ingredients on the live planning model. The Analyst Agent "builds reports from simple conversations", variance analysis runs on the same platform and flags the reasons behind gaps, and KPIs (e.g. projected year-end cash) can be set up and shown in reporting dashboards. The evidence never describes producing an actual board pack or slide deck combining metrics, variance commentary and forecast, so assembling the pack may still be partly manual. Missing for 10: an explicit board-pack or presentation generation/export feature, documented auto-generated narrative variance commentary, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
